strategy.title: What If We Experienced Human Perception at 10× Scale?
strategy.hook: Changing one condition turns visual perception into a thought experiment with surprising consequences.

story_structure.opening: Establish normal visual perception and clearly identify the single rule that will change.
story_structure.escalation: Follow three cause-and-effect consequences, increasing the stakes at each step.
story_structure.takeaway: Return to reality and show what the scenario reveals about how visual perception actually works.

strategy.audience: Curious learners who save and share clear visual explanations.
strategy.visual_direction: Cause-and-effect triptych for visual perception; normal baseline on left, altered 10× world at center, cascading consequences on right, cinematic visual continuity
